display_long_description:
Anyone can twist a throttle. Landing a Kiss of Death at full send is something else entirely.

🎮 VR Freestyle Motocross for Riders Who Want to Earn It

Stunt X Mania doesn't hand you highlights — it hands you a bike. Real clutch and gear mechanics, physics-driven handling, and a control system deep enough that your hundredth run feels nothing like your first. Auto gear makes it Easy.
[media]
🏆 12 Authentic FMX Stunts to Master
Every trick in the game comes from real FMX: Superman. Tsunami.  Cliff Hanger. Heel Clicker. Lazy Boy. One-Hand Heart Attack. 9 o'clock Nac. MC Metz,and more. Start with wheelies and endos. Work up to chaining stunts mid-air. The ceiling is high 
[media]
🔧 Make the Ride Yours
Style your rider and build your bike. Jackets, pants, helmets, engines, exhausts, and more — customize your avatar and machine until both look the way you ride.
🕹️ Three Ways to Ride

Career Mode — Climb the ranks lap by lap. Points, timers, and no shortcuts to the top.
Challenges Mode — Specific objectives that expose the gaps in your game and make you close them.
Free Roam — Your practice ground. No clock, no pressure — just reps until the trick is yours.

🎧 A Soundtrack Built for Flow State
High-energy electronic tracks from our own indie crew — the kind of rhythm that keeps you locked in run after run.
[media]
🚀 The Road Ahead
Co-op sessions, competitive multiplayer lobbies, new stunts, and new arenas are coming. The riders putting in hours now will be the ones running the lobbies later. Get your reps in.
